observations: Recovery recognizes only the exact active child-game-stop operation with provider_transition intent, matching client, actor, execution profile and child session in permitted or uncertain state.
It completes the provider stop under the persisted permit before acquiring a separate child-terminal permit.
Final stream close remains fenced by the active permit and current stream child session, preventing effects against a newer or foreign session.
The restart regression test proves both durable receipts and retirement of active operation, stream and child session.
